text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Haaah! So satisfying~~~!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Buono-chan is so powerful...! Did you see 
her around the fourth corner!?

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The intensity was unreal, you could 
practically hear the ground rumbling! I 
couldn't help but scream!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chan was great too. Small as she is, 
her power didn't lose out to Hishi Akebono 
at all. I couldn't take my eyes off 
her...!"

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
So earnest, so straightforward... Your run 
really struck a chord with me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Y-Yay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Traineeeer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup, thanks~! Guess what, guess what, 
guess what~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chan, that was the hottest one yet! 
It was just like an egg in oden!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So, like, it was sooooo much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Hishi Akebono so unusually excited 
brought a smile to my face. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bonooo--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I-I was, I was, y'know! While I was 
running, I remembered what Bono said!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
They said, "Biko is a hero!" And when they 
did, I got totally fired uuup!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I ran a super great race! I gave it 
everything I had! And they told me I did 
great!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Like I said, listen to me—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Biko Pegasus caught her breath, then 
took a deep inhale.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Race me again! On that massive stage in 
March, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll run an even, even, even 
more amazing race for you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: P-Please!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"That means you'll be even more satisfied 
than today! That's just super, duper 
amazing~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Your next race has been decided.
Your next race has been decided.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Y-Yaaay~~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, now that it's decided, I gotta give 
it my all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me! I actually made a 
boxed lunch for today~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"This'll be tonight's dinner, so let's eat 
together~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen 
approaches. Seeking even greater 
excitement and fullness, the days of 
relentless running had begun!
